Home About IIFT The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) was established in 1963 as an autonomous body under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry to contribute in the skill building for the external trade sector of India. It has come a long way to successfully develop into a unique institution involved in imparting knowledge through research and t raining in international business and trade. The Institute was granted “Deemed to be University” status in 2002. The National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) has recognized IIFT as Grade ‘A’ Institution in 2005 as well as in 2015. Over the years, IIFT has emerged as a national university with focus on International Business Management and Strategy, and such focus is reflected in all three major activities of the Institute: Research, Training and Education. 100 % Placement R inance, tech, and trzade sectors 5 Campuses New Delhi, Kolkata, and Kakinada, GIFT City, Dubai 1200 + Students Enrolled Across MBA, doctoral, and certificate programs 60 + Global Collaborations Partnerships with leading institutions worldwide 20 k+ Alumni Network Working across 100+ countries in top global firms and organizations 25 NIRF Ranking Consistently ranked among India's top B-schools 150 + Research Publications Faculty contributions to international journals and conferences 7 + Centers of Excellence Covering trade, logistics, WTO studie s, and global finance --> The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade earned the prestigious AACSB Accreditation in November 2021. With this the IIFT figures amongst the Top 5% Business Schools of the world to be accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). AACSB accreditation quality assurance system is based on 9 rigorous standards that assess mission, strategy, student learning and engagement, academic and professional engagement, and innovation in leadership and teaching.
